Heavy Rains Cause Landslides and Damage in Himachal Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh

Heavy rainfall has led to significant damage in parts of India. In Solan's Jabli area of Himachal Pradesh, a landslide caused by intense rain swept away debris, forcing a shopkeeper to abandon his establishment. Separately, in Sambhal, Uttar Pradesh, a verandah of a house collapsed due to heavy showers, burying a new tractor and a motorcycle under the rubble. The coverage indicates widespread disruption due to the monsoon season's intensity.
